sourceBinding.mathematicalFactorization: The inner exact difference algebra keeps all nonlinear M/I/J/S/Cp terms of the actual activation; the outer backward integral uses the restored original full moments and the untruncated heat kernel. These are T0, the exact leading target retained by this common family; changing b_n affects F/G but not that target.
